dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline fitting along the posterior margin from the apex to the dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a sub-5 pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear margin rising at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of base width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, large-radius convex arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a length approximately equal to its base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Very obtuse measurable angle (approx 160-170 degrees) at the transition from the melon slope to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform high-intensity cyan monochromatic coloration across the entire subject silhouette.
